name: tags_by_sequence
note: ProductTag._order = 'sequence, id' (addons/product/models/product_tag.py): the tag list as the ORM orders it, with colour and customer visibility; read-only replay over the whole population
source_sql: SELECT id, sequence, color, visible_to_customers FROM product_tag ORDER BY sequence, id

name: templates_per_tag
note: product.template.product_tag_ids many2many through product_tag_product_template_rel (addons/product/models/product_template.py), embedded as productTag.productTemplateRel: templates linked per tag, tags without templates excluded on both sides
source_sql: SELECT product_tag_id AS tag_id, count(*) AS templates FROM product_tag_product_template_rel GROUP BY product_tag_id ORDER BY product_tag_id
